name: How can I reduce window condensation in my home?

mainEntity.name: How can I reduce window condensation in my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: To reduce window condensation, focus on managing indoor humidity and improving ventilation. Use exhaust fans in kitchens and bathrooms, especially when cooking or showering. Ensure your dryer vents properly to the outside. Consider using a dehumidifier in particularly damp areas. Opening windows briefly for cross-ventilation, even in colder weather, can help exchange moist indoor air with drier outdoor air. Check that your windows are properly sealed and consider replacing older, less efficient units if humidity control doesn't resolve the issue.
acceptedAnswer.description: Reduce window condensation by managing indoor humidity with exhaust fans, dehumidifiers, and improved ventilation.
